correctness.rationale: The asserted all-W area and unique maximizing direction are established analytically by Theorem 12 planar single-plank reduction, centered-section unimodality, exact elementary cap-area formulas for the hexagon, and three verified derivative identities. Independent polygon clipping tests confirm the algebraic formulas on thousands of samples but are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Partial-plank optimization for planar bodies is a newly motivated geometric problem whose general reduction leaves a substantial direction optimization. The exact regular-hexagon problem is solved over all possible directions and widths, exhibiting a non-monotone preferred orientation with two genuinely oblique ranges and three sharp transition widths. This is a complete natural classification, rather than a routine exercise or arbitrary numerical slice; comparisons with square and restricted octagon results confirm a distinct conclusion.
